title: 🔥 SHOCKING BIBLE VERSES THAT MOST CHRISTIANS IGNORE! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 SHOCKING BIBLE VERSES THAT MOST CHRISTIANS IGNORE! 🔥
💬 "Brother John, are there Bible verses that most Christians choose to ignore? Are there hard truths in Scripture that people avoid because they’re too convicting?"

🚨 MANY CHRISTIANS LOVE ‘FEEL-GOOD’ VERSES, BUT IGNORE THE HARSH TRUTHS!
Most churches today preach love, blessings, and prosperity, but skip the harder verses about judgment, obedience, holiness, and sacrifice!

📖 Key Verse: "For the time will come when people will not put up with sound doctrine. Instead, to suit their own desires, they will gather around them a great number of teachers to say what their itching ears want to hear." (2 Timothy 4:3)
🔥 ARE YOU IGNORING THE TOUGH PARTS OF THE BIBLE? LET’S UNCOVER THE SHOCKING TRUTHS! 🔥

🔥 1. "MANY WILL THINK THEY’RE SAVED—BUT JESUS WILL REJECT THEM!"
📖 Matthew 7:21-23 – "Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only the one who does the will of my Father who is in heaven. Many will say to me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in your name and in your name drive out demons and in your name perform many miracles?’ Then I will tell them plainly, ‘I never knew you. Away from me, you evildoers!’"
💡 THIS VERSE SHOCKS MANY PEOPLE!

✔️ Just because someone calls Jesus ‘Lord’ doesn’t mean they’re truly saved.
✔️ Many will be shocked on Judgment Day when Jesus rejects them.
✔️ Only those who truly follow Christ and obey His commands will be saved.
🚨 DOES JESUS KNOW YOU, OR ARE YOU JUST RELIGIOUS?

🔥 2. "IF YOU LOVE THE WORLD, YOU ARE GOD’S ENEMY!"
📖 James 4:4 – "You adulterous people, don’t you know that friendship with the world means enmity against God? Therefore, anyone who chooses to be a friend of the world becomes an enemy of God."
💡 MOST CHRISTIANS IGNORE THIS VERSE!

✔️ You CANNOT love God and love the sinful world at the same time.
✔️ Many Christians try to blend in with the world instead of standing for Christ.
✔️ God calls compromise with the world SPIRITUAL ADULTERY!
🚨 ARE YOU A FRIEND OF GOD OR A FRIEND OF THE WORLD?

🔥 3. "IF YOU KEEP SINNING, YOU BELONG TO SATAN!"
📖 1 John 3:8 – "The one who practices sin is of the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the beginning. The reason the Son of God appeared was to destroy the devil’s work."
💡 THIS VERSE DESTROYS THE ‘ONCE SAVED, ALWAYS SAVED’ LIE!

✔️ If you continue living in sin without repentance, you are under Satan’s control!
✔️ True believers fight against sin and seek to live holy lives.
✔️ Jesus came to destroy sin, not let us live in it!
🚨 ARE YOU STILL A SLAVE TO SIN, OR HAVE YOU TRULY REPENTED?

🔥 4. "GOD WILL REJECT THOSE WHO ARE ASHAMED OF HIM!"
📖 Mark 8:38 – "If anyone is ashamed of me and my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man will be ashamed of them when he comes in his Father’s glory with the holy angels."
💡 MANY CHRISTIANS HIDE THEIR FAITH BECAUSE THEY’RE AFRAID OF PERSECUTION!

✔️ Being silent about Jesus is dangerous!
✔️ Are you afraid to talk about Christ at work, school, or online?
✔️ If you deny Jesus before men, He will deny you before the Father! (Matthew 10:33)
🚨 ARE YOU A BOLD CHRISTIAN, OR ARE YOU ASHAMED OF JESUS?

🔥 5. "YOU MUST FORGIVE OTHERS—OR GOD WON’T FORGIVE YOU!"
📖 Matthew 6:14-15 – "For if you forgive other people when they sin against you, your heavenly Father will also forgive you. But if you do not forgive others their sins, your Father will not forgive your sins."
💡 THIS VERSE IS HARD FOR MANY PEOPLE TO ACCEPT!

✔️ Holding grudges is a serious sin!
✔️ If you refuse to forgive others, God will not forgive you.
✔️ Bitterness, hatred, and unforgiveness destroy your soul.
🚨 ARE YOU HOLDING UNFORGIVENESS IN YOUR HEART?

📢 FAITH DECLARATION!
💬 "I CHOOSE TO OBEY THE WHOLE BIBLE, NOT JUST THE EASY PARTS!"

🔥 THE BIBLICAL TRUTH CHALLENGE!
✅ Step 1: Read these shocking verses again—don’t ignore them!
✅ Step 3: Commit to living out the WHOLE Word of God!

🙏 PRAYER FOR OBEDIENCE TO GOD’S WORD! 🙏
Heavenly Father, I come before You with an open heart. Forgive me for the times I have ignored the hard truths in Your Word. Lord, give me the courage to obey ALL of Your commands, not just the easy ones.
Jesus, I want to know You, not just in words, but in my actions. Remove every form of compromise from my life. Let me walk in boldness, holiness, and true faithfulness to Your teachings.
Holy Spirit, convict me when I am tempted to ignore or twist Scripture to fit my desires. I surrender to the FULL truth of Your Word!
🔥 In Jesus’ mighty name, I pray. Amen! 🔥
🔥 #ShockingBibleVerses #BiblicalTruth #WakeUpChurch #JesusIsLord #EndTimesWarning #GospelWarrior #JohnXAsis
